calendar.revision_policy: Actual exchange closure/calendar revision must be documented and confirmed; do not replace failed collection days with later successful days.

rules: Preserve v1/v2/v3 protocols, historical windows and all incomplete results. v4 has a new user-requested forward window, not modified acceptance thresholds.
BaoStock is the sole primary price source: exact code/date/batch, frequency d, adjustflag 3, original raw hash and real receipt time. Never assemble a price tuple across suppliers.

tradestatus=0 proves suspension even when volume/amount are empty. tradestatus=1 with finite strictly positive volume proves not suspended. Missing/zero/negative volume does not prove False; empty volume/amount are never replaced by zero. isST=0/1 alone supplies the dated ST fact.

Limits reuse v1 normal_price_band with BaoStock preclose and close: supported ordinary main board 10%, ChiNext 300/301 20%, Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to cents. Require dated listing-calendar evidence proving more than five listed sessions and explicit ordinary trading-regime evidence. Missing regime proof, special regime, IPO, ST, suspension, unsupported STAR/BJ boards or price anomaly means limits None. Never fabricate ordinary=True.

Tushare daily is a separate unadjusted close/pre_close cross-check within 0.005. Unavailable is reported; conflicting primary prices prevent negative limit conclusions. No stk_limit, suspend_d, stock_basic or trade_cal requests on this route.

Eastmoney stock/get is an independent limit reference only: rc=0, exact f57, f59=2, f43/f60/f51/f52 positive finite scaled prices, same-session after-close f86 no later than actual receipt; stock/get close/preclose must match primary prices within 0.005. Missing/stale/mismatched bounds or prices remain None.

Only complete paginated namechange can independently reference historical ST; keep actual receipt, active interval and announcement date. Permission/transport/incomplete-page failures are recorded and do not stop other fields. Missing ST reference still means ST acceptance incomplete, not a relaxed threshold.
AKShare dated limit pools supply positive references only, never False from absence. BaoStock cannot independently validate its own suspension/ST, and Tushare price agreement is not risk agreement.

Use all declared dates and the whole daily universe including missing rows, unsupported stocks, unknowns and failed calls in coverage reporting. Report each field separately; incomplete suspension/ST reference must not prevent limit diagnostics, but prevents whole-tuple acceptance.

Later receipts are research references only, never point-in-time prediction inputs. No tomorrow/current snapshot is backdated into a missed session. No trading, recommendation or production license follows automatically from archive completion or passing local tests.

collection.raw_policy: Save original response bytes, SHA256 and real received_at for every response including invalid/error responses. Append-only per-run index and logs; exclusive directories; complete transport capture is distinct from valid reference coverage.
collection.enable_policy: No requests, timer installation or service start before explicit user approval and a frozen protocol whose byte hash matches a separate approval record. Stop automatically after the declared 20-date window; continuation requires confirmation.

activation: Draft only. User confirmation is required before freeze and collection enable. Separate evidence review and explicit confirmation are required before licensing, production integration, full verification/release, main merge and backed-up plugin-only reload.
